QuestionStmt.S:
Identify the substrate 'X' in the following reaction.

$$X + O_2 \xrightarrow{\text{i) Co-naphthenate, 423 K}} \text{Phenol} + \text{Acetone}$$

Solution.S: The given reaction is the cumene process for the industrial preparation of phenol. Cumene (isopropylbenzene) is oxidized with air in the presence of a cobalt naphthenate catalyst at 423 K to form cumene hydroperoxide. Upon hydrolysis with dilute HCl, it decomposes to give phenol and acetone. Therefore, the substrate X is isopropyl benzene, which corresponds to option D.
